  • Controlar e monitorar indicadores de desempenho de compras, gerando relatórios gerenciais para acompanhamento.
  • Implementar e manter políticas e procedimentos internos para o setor de compras, assegurando a padronização e eficiência dos processos.
  • Coordenar o processo de seleção, homologação e avaliação de fornecedores.
  • Gerir contratos de fornecimento, assegurando o cumprimento de cláusulas e evitando riscos financeiros e operacionais.
  • Viagens para apoio ao processo de compras nos contratos.

  • Organização.
  • Visão estratégica.
  • Liderança.
  • Senso de urgência.
  • Negociação.
  • Foco em resultado.

  • Empresa: Alves da Cunha Engenharia
  • Local de Trabalho: Salvador/BA

Requisitos
  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Suprimentos ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência em negociação com fornecedores e gestão de contratos.
  • Habilidade em análise de custos e estratégias de redução de despesas.
  • Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de gestão de compras.

    • Manutenção de instalações elétricas prediais de média e baixa tensão, em regime contínuo, com capacidade igual ou superior a 225 kVA;

    • Identificação do signatário e da empresa emitente;

    • Descrição das atividades executadas, incluindo características, quantidades e prazos;

Efetuar contagem física diária das quantidades liberadas no estoque, a fim de manter estoque controlado bem como apoiar a área administrativa com informações para confronto físico versus contábil.

Realizar a leitura da carga para expedição e controle de rastreabilidade.

Preencher checklist em formulário específico para liberação dos veículos, assegurando o atendimento às normas de segurança, segurança da carga, multas e exigências de qualidade.

Participar em inventários, informando as contagens dos produtos por família e quantidade apurada, atendendo as necessidades da empresa para controle e redução de custos com perda de estoque.

Verificar lista de exigência cadastrada para outbound de clientes, informando as datas permanecentes no estoques, a fim de apurar a validade dos produtos no FIFO (First In, First Out), visando o atendimento correto dos lotes de validade cadastrados para os clientes e informativo interno de controle.

Movimentação Materiais

Operar equipamento de movimentação, como empilhadeira frontal, empilhadeira retrátil e transpaleteira conforme demanda e permissão de uso, garantindo o atendimento da demanda de produção e logística para dar continuidade no processo de armazenagem, distribuição e produção.

Efetuar checklist do equipamento, inspecionando todos os pontos no início da atividade, visando conservar o bom estado de funcionamento do equipamento ou identificar necessidades de manutenção preventiva, evitando assim prejudicar a produtividade dos equipamentos e comprometer a segurança de sua operação e das pessoas que o rodeiam.

Abastecer a linha de paletização com paletes vazios, respeitando a quantidade limitada, atendendo ao processo produtivo.

Retirar os paletes prontos da linha de paletização e realizar o strechamento dos mesmos quando necessário, verificando se está dentro do padrão de qualidade preestabelecido e efetuando todos os trâmites de rastreabilidade do produto.

Realizar a armazenagem dos paletes produzidos, utilizando equipamento apropriado para movimentação dos mesmos e seguindo os padrões do estoque, prezando pela organização da área.

Separar cargas, conforme demanda e orientação, posicionando a mesma no local indicado para que seja realizado o carregamento, além de efetuar o carregamento com equipamento apropriado, garantindo a vazão do produto acabado e atendimento do cliente.

Colocar a empilhadeira/transpaleteira no conector para iniciar o processo de carga do equipamento.

Movimentar os paletes no estoque, conforme orientação para armazenamento e movimentações dos produtos diante das necessidades da área, facilitando a disponibilidade dos produtos liberados para inventário, venda ou transferência.

Descarregar os paletes com produtos recebidos em veículos, possibilitando a conferência para abastecimento do estoque, retornos ou devoluções de outras operações de clientes.

Prestar suporte no recebimento de materiais, descarregando caminhões quando necessário, conferindo notas fiscais e pedido, bem como efetuando lançamento no sistema informatizado, garantindo o abastecimento da fábrica e controle preciso dos materiais e insumos.

Efetuar o abastecimento da manufatura, transferindo os materiais e insumos locados em estoque, utilizando equipamentos apropriados para a movimentação, garantindo a continuidade do processo produtivo.

Controlar estoque, através de sistema informatizado e planilhas eletrônicas, mantendo as informações atualizadas, bem como efetuar contagem do estoque de insumos e peças técnicas, registrando a informação em relatório próprio para posterior conferência com o sistema, assegurando que o estoque esteja em conformidade com o sistema.

Providenciar, quando demandado, entrega de EPIs, uniformes e peças técnicas, seguindo procedimentos preestabelecidos, com o objetivo de disponibilizar o recurso necessário e obrigatórios.

Abastecer produto acabado segregado na área destinada ao reprocessamento de produto, respeitando as datas de vencimento e tipo, possibilitando que o produto destinado ao reprocessamento não vença em estoque e gere custo de descarte.

Organizar o estoque interno de consumíveis, respeitando o procedimento FIFO (First In, First Out) para posterior abastecimento das áreas de produção, garantindo disponibilidade de espaço físico para recebimento de novos insumos e abastecimento das áreas de produção.

Movimentar os bags de café torrado e/ou torrado e moído destinados a descarte para as áreas corretas, possibilitando a correta destinação do café não conforme e assim evitando o uso não intencional pelas áreas de produção.

  • Familiarity with Azure SQL Hyperscale, Cosmos DB modeling, and Redis patterns.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

title: Gerente Comercial
description:
O Gerente Comercial é o profissional que atua dentro da empresa, atendendo o cliente, negociando interesses e coordenando o time responsável pela realização de um serviço. Ele será o responsável por organizar os recursos humanos e materiais disponíveis, alocando-os de acordo às necessidades, além de elaborar um cronograma de ações e disponibilizá-lo para todos os envolvidos no serviço.

Gestão de pessoas, processos, budget, prazos, produtos e insumos.

Missão do cargo:

Gerenciamento da unidade, time, resultados, organização e bom funcionamento.

Principais responsabilidades:

Gestão, treinamento, capacitação e desenvolvimento do time. Parcerias para ações dentro e fora da unidade. Entrega das metas da unidade, assim como manter o funcionamento da unidade e de todos os seus processos dentro dos padrões exigidos pela franqueadora, conforme manuais e compliance.

Principais competências:

Liderança, comunicação, persuação, proatividade, dinamismo, negociação, organização, planejamento, influência, visão estratégica, visão de mercado, ética, foco no cliente, expertise para vendas presencial e online.

Atividades:

  • Treina e desenvolve o time com as normas de atendimento padrões da empresa, garantindo e planejando um atendimento de excelência para os clientes;
  • Treina e desenvolve o time para alcance das metas da unidades;
  • Responsável pela gestão de pessoas e resultados da unidade;
  • Responsável por montar escalas mensais do time;
  • Gerencia e direciona atividades do time;
  • Atua na implantação e correção de procedimentos padrões;
  • Realiza avaliação de novos clientes;
  • Executa vendas e revendas dos pacotes de depilação a laser;
  • Presta atendimento e esclarece dúvidas de clientes;
  • Faz tratativa com cliente afim de evitar cancelamento de contrato;
  • Realiza desligamento de colaboradoras;
  • Fornece feedbacks e faz follow-up, visando corrigir comportamentos dos colaboradores dentro do ambiente de trabalho, além de melhorias em cada setor.
  • Extrai relatórios do sistema;
  • Responsável pelo bom funcionamento e manutenção e higiene da unidade;
  • Co-responsável pelo acompanhamento de todas as intercorrências e resultados desfavoráveis, prestando assistência e esclarecimentos ao cliente;
  • Desenvolve estudos sobre o potencial de vendas da região, realiza parcerias e prospecção de clientes para ações internas (unidade) e externas (rua), visando a ampliação do volume de negócios;
  • Apresenta estratégias e planos de ação para gerente de apoio/franqueado;
  • Reporta necessidade de manutenção na unidade;
  • Reporta informações sobre equipe e resultados para gerente de apoio/franqueado;
  • Monitora toda a documentação exigida pelos órgãos fiscalizadores e reportar para o escritório.

Esse cargo não é pra você:

Se você não possui afinidade com a gestão de equipes de vendas, desenvolvimento de estratégias comerciais, alcance de metas desafiadoras ou não segue o direcionamento aplicado por sua gestora, este cargo pode não ser o ideal.

A posição de Gerente Comercial requer uma liderança proativa, seguir diretrizes pré estabelecidas, habilidade em elaborar e implementar estratégias de vendas eficazes, além de habilidade para analisar resultados e ajustá-los conforme necessário.

Nosso objetivo é encontrar alguém que seja apaixonado por impulsionar resultados e liderar equipes rumo ao sucesso. Se a ideia de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e voltado para resultados não o entusiasma, esta posição pode não ser adequada para você. CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. Compreende a prestação de serviços especializados voltado para qualquer ação que realize trabalho socioeducativo e pedagógico sobre a questão de eficiência energética, seja com cliente de baixa renda, residencial, comércio e serviço, unidade do poder público ou outros na área de abrangência das distribuidoras de energia do grupo Neoenergia. O Projeto Aulas de Energia realiza ações educativas para estudantes e público avulso visando a disseminação do uso seguro e eficiente da energia elétrica através de conteúdos e equipamentos específicos. As ações são realizadas na capital e no interior do Estado da Bahia.

Atuar na interlocução com os líderes locais e gestores escolares para a apresentação, entrada e permanência das ações nas comunidades, unidades escolares, em municípios de toda a área de abrangência das distribuidoras; Acompanhar a equipe subordinada em suas atividades; Fazer palestras educativas sobre Eficiência Energética; Supervisionar e monitorar as instalações físicas e condições para execuções dos serviços inerentes às ações, identificando necessidades de reparos ou manutenção; Supervisionar e monitorar os materiais e equipamentos disponibilizados para execução das ações; Supervisionar e coordenar o trabalho das equipes diretamente subordinadas monitorando os indicadores e gerando relatórios; Validar a localização e solicitar a ligação provisória de energia elétrica da UM nas localidades onde serão realizados os atendimentos; Interlocução com secretarias de Educação e demais órgãos competentes para convênios e parcerias; Identificar e sinalizar a necessidade de treinamentos específicos para as equipes; Identificar e sinalizar problemas na execução das atividades, propondo melhorias no processo.

Join to apply for the Solutions Architect II (Webflow Experience) role at Outliant.

About Us

Outliant is a fully remote, US-based digital product development and startup consulting company with a team of culturally diverse creators whose exceptional skills and talents help conceive seamless digital products. Our teams exhibit work‑play energy that supports individual growth as well as encourages freedom of creativity and “thinking outside the box.”

Core Values:

  • Pursuit of Excellence: We are extremely competitive, ambitious, and driven to be exceptional – as individuals, teams, and an organization.
  • Startup Mentality: Outliant began with 5 startup founders, and startup culture is deep in our DNA.
  • World‑Class Remote Collaboration: Outliant is a 100% remote company – we have no offices, and our teams are distributed around the world.
About The Role

We're looking to hire a full‑time remote Solutions Architect II for Webflow‑based projects. You'll be empowered to define your own work and set the technical vision for assigned projects. Given broad business direction, you'll generate new frameworks, concepts, and methodologies within the solution architecture field. You'll be responsible for crafting your own roadmap and creating challenging yet achievable projects, fostering an environment of continuous learning and growth. This role requires working in EST (Eastern Standard Time). Seniority Level: Senior Level.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across various departments to understand their needs and challenges at a strategic level.
  • Analyze complex business requirements and translate them into innovative and future‑proof technical solutions.
  • Generate and promote new concepts, principles, and methods within the solution architecture discipline.
  • Design and architect highly scalable, secure, and cost‑effective solutions, considering emerging technologies and industry best practices.
  • Select and integrate cutting‑edge technologies (hardware, software, cloud) to build robust and efficient solutions, including Webflow, React, Node.js, Google Tag Manager, and Google Analytics.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to ensure knowledge transfer and ongoing solution effectiveness.
  • Lead presentations and discussions, effectively defending your proposed solutions to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure seamless implementation of your designed solutions.
  • Identify opportunities for optimisation within existing systems and propose innovative solutions to improve overall efficiency.
  • Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies, actively evaluating and integrating them into your solution strategy.
  • Mentor junior Solution Architects and contribute to internal knowledge sharing initiatives.
  • Lead and guide teams to achieve project and organisational goals.
Requirements
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in solution architecture or a related technical role (e.g., software development, DevOps, systems engineering).
  • Hands‑on experience with Webflow, ReactJS, and Node.js.
  • 3–5 years of experience in solution design and implementation, with expertise in a specific domain (e.g., cloud computing, security).
  • Proven track record of successfully leading and executing complex technical projects.
  • Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to the role, including cloud computing, enterprise architecture, and IT security.
  • Strong ability to generate innovative solutions and develop new approaches within the solution architecture field.
  • Strong communicator who can bridge the gap between technical and non‑technical audiences.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to think strategically and consider long‑term implications.
  • Experience implementing and managing Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics for web projects.
  • Certification in solution architecture (e.g., AWS/Azure Solutions Architect or Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect) is a plus.
  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns and best practices.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Strong understanding of microservices architecture and containerisation technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Ability to create and maintain comprehensive documentation of architecture designs and solutions.
  • Experience with automation and orchestration tools.
  • Familiarity with compliance and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and guide technical teams.
  • Ability to stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Experience in managing stakeholder expectations and delivering high‑quality solutions on time and within budget.
  • A personal computer with stable internet connection.

description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 30 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You’ll Do
  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible for delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team
An Ideal Candidate Should Have
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders
Bonus:
  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS
Technologies we use:
  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit
What We offer
  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
  • A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
  • An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
  • Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
  • Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
  • Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
  • Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Descrição da vaga

Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante. #VemSerKover!

Time Kovi

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover! ♥

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O que buscamos? Estamos procurando um City Manager altamente dinâmico e prático para Salvador, que seja apaixonado por mobilidade e esteja disposto a crescer conosco. Esta é uma oportunidade única para participar da expansão de nossas operações em Campinas e causar um impacto significativo no futuro da mobilidade urbana.

  • Disponibilidade para viagens.

  • Habilidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas, com experiência prática e capacidade de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e análise.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.
  • Flexibilidade para se adaptar a prioridades e responsabilidades em constante mudança.
  • Excelentes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes.
  • Conhecimento do mercado B2C e melhores práticas de atendimento ao cliente.
Informações adicionais

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.
  • Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.
  • Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

  • Kovenção: A reunião que a liderança da Kovi tem com a empresa inteira para que todos fiquem por dentro do status do negócio.

Seja um Kover e venha transformar vidas através da mobilidade

Sobre a Kovi

Na Kovi, acreditamos que mobilidade muda direções. Nascemos em 2018 com um propósito claro: criar oportunidades para que todos possam dirigir suas vidas. Hoje, somos referência em oferecer soluções inovadoras para clientes, promovendo inclusão financeira e autonomia para quem movimenta as cidades.

Mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia, somos um time apaixonado por impacto real. Aqui, combinamos dados, empatia e ousadia para criar um ecossistema justo, sustentável e acessível. E isso é só o começo.

Nossa cultura

Nossa cultura é viva, diversa e colaborativa. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas, que aprendem rápido, pensam diferente e constroem junto. Na Kovi, você tem liberdade para ser quem é, e espaço para crescer como nunca imaginou.

Acreditamos no poder da inovação como motor da mudança. Por isso, incentivamos ideias novas, experimentações e decisões com base em dados. Também somos movidos por um forte senso de dono: cada pessoa aqui é protagonista da sua jornada.

Diversidade importa. Inclusão também. Por isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Vamos juntos?

Se você busca propósito, desafios reais e quer fazer parte de um time que está reinventando o presente para construir um futuro mais justo, seu lugar pode ser aqui.

Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Salvador, Brazil

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Speechify’s text-to-speech products help users convert any text into audio to read faster, read more, and remember more. Our products include iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome Extension, and Web Apps. Speechify has been recognized for its design and accessibility innovations.

We operate as a fully distributed team with no office, collaborating globally across frontend and backend engineering, AI research, and other roles.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining backend services, including payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text-to-speech, and external APIs. This role is ideal for someone who thinks strategically, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making product decisions that delight users. We value leadership demonstrated through technical excellence and consistent, fast delivery. Strong work ethic and clear communication are essential.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

Overview (Data & AI)

We are hiring for the Data side of Speechify’s AI team. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support model training operations. We build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join us.

What You’ll Do
  • Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
  • Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform
  • Collaborate with Scientists to optimize cost, throughput, and quality to power next-generation models
  • Collaborate with the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team’s dataset roadmap
An Ideal Candidate Should Have
  • BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field
  • 5+ years of industry experience in software development
  • Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
  • Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
  • Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
What We Offer
  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a transformative industry
  • Competitive compensation, a friendly atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • Opportunity to work on a product that helps people with learning differences
  • Work at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio

Note : Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES

  • 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
  • Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
  • Proven ability to build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
  • Experience in building subscription-based products with a track record of driving growth;
  • Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
  • A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
  • Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
  • Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
  • Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Deep understanding of gaming trends;
  • Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
  • Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Arquiteto/Tech Lead – Sistemas de Autorização (ISO 8583)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Responsabilidades e atribuições


O que esperamos que você realize:

Responsável por liderar a arquitetura, evolução técnica e boas práticas de desenvolvimento de sistemas críticos de autorização de transações financeiras, com foco em alta disponibilidade, performance e segurança. Atuará como referência técnica para o time, garantindo a aderência aos padrões de mercado e a integração eficiente com sistemas de pagamento baseados no protocolo ISO 8583.


Responsabilidades Principais

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de sistemas de autorização financeira baseados em ISO 8583.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas e orientar o time no desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis e resilientes.
  • Garantir a integração eficiente com terminais, adquirentes e emissores via mensagens ISO 8583.
  • Projetar e revisar modelos de dados em Oracle, otimizando consultas SQL e PL/SQL.
  • Supervisionar o ciclo de vida de aplicações em ambientes WebSphere e JBoss.
  • Promover a adoção de microserviços com Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Data e Security.
  • Estabelecer e manter pipelines de CI/CD com Azure DevOps e infraestrutura em AWS.
  • Definir estratégias de conteinerização com Docker e orquestração com Kubernetes.
  • Documentar e versionar APIs RESTful e SOAP com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Aplicar padrões de design e boas práticas de engenharia de software.
  • Atuar como facilitador técnico em squads ágeis, promovendo colaboração e entrega contínua.

title: Data Engineer_ Snowflake
description:
Job Description: Senior Snowflake Data Engineer (Migration & Modelling)

Location: Brazil/ Costa Rica (Remote)

Job Type: Contract / Project-Based (Staff Augmentation)

Note : Need to support PST timings


Project Summary:

We are seeking highly skilled Snowflake Data Engineers to act as augmented members of a client's data team. You will be responsible for the hands-on execution of a complex, end-to-end data platform migration to Snowflake.

This is a hands-on execution role. You will be expected to integrate seamlessly with the existing team and take direct ownership of critical migration and data modelling tasks to accelerate the project's delivery. This is a complex transformation, not a simple "lift-and-shift."


Key Responsibilities:

  • Data Modelling & Architecture:
  • Collaborate with the client's BI and Data Science teams to define data requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models (e.g., Dimensional, Star Schema) optimized for Snowflake.
  • Develop and document data models, data definitions, and data flow diagrams for the new environment.
  • Data Migration & Engineering:
  • Execute the hands-on technical migration of data from legacy systems to the Snowflake Data Cloud
  • Engineer, build, and optimize robust ELT/ETL data pipelines within Snowflake (using SnowSQL, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, etc.).
  • Implement and automate data quality checks and validation processes to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
  • Team Integration & Delivery:
  • Integrate directly with the client's data team, participating in all relevant project routines and workflows.
  • Take ownership of assigned migration and modeling tasks, delivering high-quality, production-ready code and models with minimal supervision.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to data migration, modeling, and pipeline performance.
  • Create clear technical documentation for all developed assets (models, pipelines, etc.).


Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Expert-level Snowflake: Deep, proven, hands-on experience with the Snowflake platform (architecture, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, performance optimization).
  • Expert-level Data Modeling: 4+ years of dedicated experience in data modeling (Dimensional, Relational) and data warehousing architecture.
  • Proven Data Migration: 4+ years of experience executing complex, large-scale data warehouse migrations (non-lift-and-shift).
  • Strong Data Engineering: Proficiency in building data pipelines (ELT/ETL) using SQL and modern tools (e.g., dbt, Python, or similar).
  • Execution Focus: A proven "do-er" with the ability to integrate into an existing team and deliver on complex technical tasks independently.
  • BI / Analytics Acumen: Strong understanding of how data models are consumed by BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, etc.) and Data Science workloads.

title: Consultor(a) SAP Basis - Sênior
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos procurando um(a) Consultor(a) SAP Basis Pleno/Sênior para atuar na administração de ambientes SAP complexos, tanto on-premise quanto em nuvem. Essa pessoa será responsável pela sustentação técnica, melhorias contínuas e participação ativa em projetos de atualização, migração e arquitetura SAP, com foco em Managed Services.


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Administração de ambientes SAP ECC, S/4HANA e componentes relacionados;
  • Instalação, upgrade e aplicação de pacotes técnicos (Support Package, Kernel, EHP);
  • Troubleshooting, análise de performance e resolução de incidentes críticos;
  • Apoio técnico à equipe e documentação de boas práticas;
  • Suporte a projetos em cloud (AWS/Azure) e migração para HANA.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis e administração de ambientes SAP;
  • Conhecimento em NetWeaver, S/4HANA e Solution Manager 7.2;
  • Conhecimento em administração de usuários, governança, GRC-AC/PC;
  • Sistemas operacionais (Linux/Windows) e bancos HANA ou Oracle;
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, análise de dumps, logs e performance.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e suporte SAP.


Diferenciais:


  • Certificação SAP Basis (ex: C_TADM_21), Cloud (AWS/Azure) ou HANA;
  • Experiência com ambientes SAP em cloud pública (AWS, Azure, GCP);
  • Experiência com automação (scripts, Ansible) e monitoração (Zabbix, Focused Run);
  • Vivência em projetos de migração (SWPM, DMO, SUM) e upgrades.


Regime de Contratação: Modelo de CLT


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Business Developer for Social Media
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works. Our current search is a Business Developer for identifying and developing strategic opportunities across major social media platforms.


This role sits at the intersection of business development, content partnerships, and M&A opportunities within the creator economy.


As a Business Developer, you will be responsible for identifying high-potential content channels, engaging with creators and channel owners, evaluating monetization opportunities, and structuring commercial partnerships that support our company’s growth strategy.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify high-revenue potential YouTube, Facebook, and Snapchat channels aligned with the business goals
  • Engage with content creators and/or channel owners to assess the value and potential of their channels
  • Develop and present commercial proposals to creators and channel owners
  • Onboard new partners (creators or channel owners) into the company’s operational processes
  • Explore and analyze new opportunities across social platforms to accelerate company growth
  • Collaborate closely with platform managers, the data/strategy team, and company executives (CEOs) to align business opportunities with strategic priorities


Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken
  • Strong understanding of the creator economy and social media content monetization
  • Genuine interest in digital content and the evolution of social platforms
  • Proven negotiation and deal-making abilities
  • Ability to craft compelling commercial offers and proposals
  • Strong autonomy, organization, and project management skills
  • Experience in business development, partnerships, or M&A related to digital media or entertainment


If you think everything suits you, hit the apply button!


Please upload your updated CV in English!

title: Senior Front-End Software Engineer
description:
Senior Front-End Software Engineer (React.js)

We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Front-End Software Engineer with at least 5 years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with GraphQL.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and UI scaffolding to ensure an optimal user experience.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI and full-stack engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders of Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities operate and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Work closely with UI/UX designers to build, implement, and maintain scalable front-end applications, ensuring delivery of unparalleled user experiences
  • Architecture : Lead front-end architectural decisions, implementing best practices in performance optimization and responsive design
  • Leadership : Provide leadership within the development team, fostering a learning and growth environment
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments utilizing React.js
  • Experience with GraphQL
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience with Python, Golang, Node.js, or Java
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are committed to delivering world-class remote resources that enable our valued client team members to work effectively. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Principal Engineer – Guidance & Control (Technical Leader)
description:
Location: On-Site position based in the UAE (Full Relocation Package)


A leading defense company based in the United Arab Emirates is seeking an exceptional Principal Engineer to act as the Technical Leader for Guidance and Control (G&C) systems . This is a strategic, high-impact and hands-on role with an explicit mandate to establish and lead new G&C capabilities, mentor engineers, and drive the future of guided weapon platforms.


The Role: Technical Authority & Capability Builder


As the Principal Engineer for G&C, you will be the technical backbone of the department, reporting directly to the Department Manager. Your responsibilities include:

  • G&C Technical Leadership: Serving as the technical authority over the full G&C lifecycle, including Modeling & Simulation (MIL/SIL/PIL) , Guidance & Control Algorithms , Tracking Systems , and Estimation Filters (EKF/KF) .
  • R&D and Capability Establishment: Leading the investigation of emerging technologies and the implementation of futuristic methodologies. You will be responsible for establishing new G&C infrastructure, tools, and R&D labs .
  • Flight Test Oversight: Managing all phases of flight test campaigns, including pre-flight preparation, test execution, and rigorous post-flight analysis .
  • Mentorship and Team Building: Providing technical guidance and mentoring to engineers across all levels (Junior to Senior), helping to cultivate a high-performing team.


Requirements for Success


  • Experience: 10–15 years of experience in the development of guided weapon systems , missiles, or relevant defense technologies.
  • Leadership: A minimum of 5 years of experience in engineering management and technical leadership roles, with a proven ability to lead teams and establish new capabilities.
  • Expertise: Deep knowledge of the entire Systems Engineering Process (qualification, acceptance, flight testing) and a strong background in flight dynamics, embedded systems, and missile control .
  • Qualifications: A Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.


Ready for Your Next Career Move?


This is a Full-Time Employee (FTE) position requiring a professional who is willing to relocate to Abu Dhabi, UAE . A full relocation package is offered to ensure a smooth transition.


This role offers a clear career path toward Senior Principal Engineer and Chief Engineer , allowing you to directly shape the technological future of defense in the region.

If you are a result-driven technical leader ready to build and innovate in a high-stakes environment, we want to hear from you.


Apply now and help us establish next-generation guidance and control capabilities!

title: Gerente de vendas - Terraplanagem
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas para terraplanagem, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;

title: SAP Fiori
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Dev BTP UI5 Fiori who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and maintain BTP Fiori applications for SAP Dynamic Forms.

The ideal candidate will have 3–7 years of hands-on experience in SAP UI5 development and should be highly skilled in building responsive, scalable, and user-friendly enterprise applications.

SAP UI5 / Fiori: Strong experience in developing, customizing, and extending Fiori/UI5 applications

SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform): Hands-on experience with BTP services, particularly in application development and deployment

Frontend Development: Strong skills in JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, JSON, XML

UI/UX Design: Experience creating responsive and user-friendly applications

OData Services: Proficient in consuming and integrating OData services; knowledge of SAP Gateway

Development Tools: SAP Business Application Studio (BAS), SAP Web IDE, Git

Version Control & CI/CD: Familiar with GitHub/GitLab, Jenkins, or other CI/CD pipelines

Performance Optimization: Ability to optimize UI5 apps for performance and scalability

Experience with CAP (Cloud Application Programming) Model on SAP BTP

Exposure to Node.js, REST APIs, or microservices architecture

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies

Understanding of security concepts (authentication, authorization in SAP BTP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de DevOps, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, FastAPI ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com Terraform, Python, C, C++, AWS, Linux, CI/CD e SQL.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Capital Agents
description:
We’re Expanding Our Global Capital Agent Network – Join Magnum Equities as an Independent Capital Agent


Remote | Global | Commission-Based | #PrivateEquity #CapitalRaising #InvestmentOpportunities #CapitalAgent #Agent #Broker #InvestmentBanker #PrivateMarkets #VentureCapital #Entrepreneurship


Are you a capital introducer, private banker, independent dealmaker, ultra-networker, or connected investment professional looking to monetize your network?


Magnum is seeking experienced Capital Agents to join our global sourcing network. These independent agents will facilitate capital to Magnum Equities and earn 2% commission on successfully funded partnership capital placements, from fiat currency to crypto currency.


Capital Agent – Independent Investment Sourcing Partner


Location: Global | Remote

Full | Part-time or Side gig with your current job


Industry: You can be of any industry sector background, early/mid/or late in your career, having a capital network of partnership investment prospects that desire high ROI via profit share in Magnum’s global real estate and business equities assets growth forward, and large-scale social impact.


Commission: 2% of Capital Raised


About Magnum Equities


Magnum is foremost a mass capital investment partnership platform, capital raise platform for SME's, and mass social impact/empowerment powerhouse. Magnum's main pillars: Real Estate Assets Partners | Tech/Business Equity Partners | Precious Metals | Sukuk (Marabaha) enabling Shariah compliant capital placement investment from micro to macro capital partners, via “Magnum Equities Partnership Tokenization". Enabling globally democratized - low barrier to entry (min 50 Euros/token) - investment, empowering individuals to large institutional capital placement participation in Magnum’s global portfolio rather than being limited to only a specific single asset, optimizing short/medium/long term (3-5yrs), ROI (3X/5X/10X/100X/2500X+), and abatement of any singular asset downside. Magnum also empowers Capital Agents with lucrative revenue streams for their facilitated capital. These can be individuals, SF/MF Private offices, fund managers, capital management firms, institutional etc. Fiat currency, & crypto currency investment enabled.


Our global investors are significantly advantaged leveraging their purchase of Magnum’s RWA tokens as profit share rights in Magnum's aggregate global performance forward. Micro to Macro partnerships via fractional partnership profit share tokenization on blockchain via our RWA/PropTech blockchain/fintech partner portal.


Magnum’s innovative fractional partnership structure provides flexibility to vest capital across GCC/MENA/North America Strategic Growth region assets without requiring local RWA tokenization adoption. Magnum enables periodic ROI distributions based on portfolio-wide performance metrics via smart contracts.


Magnum’s cutting edge RWA tokenized profit share partnership model maintains investors’ blockchain-enabled transparency.


Magnum provides its profit share partners/investors with what entities such as Berkshire Hathaway have provided capital investors, except much more opportunity, scope, innovation integration, social impact, & mass low barrier of entry to participate - individually to institutionally.

With Magnum, whether your vested fractional profit share tokens are aligned with our entire Real Estate focused portfolio, or as accredited investor choosing from our globally located Cross-industry sector companies seeking to raise capital, or both, you’re not stuck with just one asset, gated entry points, or vague returns. It’s about real productive assets you can see, touch, and feel, as well as large-scale pan-global business equity positions. Partners get fractional profit share access to a massive diverse portfolio, smart contract-driven payouts, and a model built for transparency and real growth.


Magnum is foremost a global partnership investment platform that lets you own fractional profit share rights in real-world assets (Large Scale Real Estate and Cross-Industry Business Equity)—tokenized for transparency, diversification, and ease of access. Think of it as owning a piece of a global portfolio, without needing millions to get started. Magnum is also engineered to be a democratizing, equal opportunity, income/earnings empowerment platform for often displaced masses of global micro investors to institutional, that want to be associated with a mass legacy-driven, cutting edge investment and social impact platform that empowers and restores micro-investor hope, dignity, respect, income equality, standard of living, growth, and vision within an investment climate that has historically displaced the masses. Magnum levels the playing field, ensuring equal opportunity and low barrier to entry. Is it a global movement? We think so.


Who does Magnum serve


Our model supports everyone—from Micro partners/investors (global individuals) to UHNW, Single/Multi-Family Offices, Institutional – Pension | Insurance | SWF | Investment Authorities | Endowments | Foundation/Charitable | PE Funds | VC | Hedge | Real Estate | Infrastructure Funds etc. while empowering all our capital agents.


Role Overview


As a Capital Agent, you will:


  • Introduce and complete partner funding qualified capital partners/investors to the Magnum platform
  • Facilitate warm introductions and/or participate in closing efforts
  • Earn 2% on capital you raise – Simple!
  • Operate independently and flexibly, without exclusive commitment


What We Offer


  • Attractive transparent commission model - Unique Agent link to use | Earnings wallet
  • Leverage Magnum’s professionally curated pitch decks, site resources etc
  • Flexible, remote-first role – ideal for global professionals
  • Dedicated support: Capital partner relationship team and due diligence assistance
  • No licensing required (you are not soliciting or selling securities directly), only introductions to partnership
  • Global flexibility: Operate remotely, with no territory or geographic limits


Who This Is For


  • Individuals, capital introducers, private bankers, fund managers, capital firms, representative/legal firms, brokers, salespeople, investment professionals, endowments, charitable orgs with access to capital and capital networks
  • Individuals with relationships across single/multifamily offices, UHNWIs, boutique funds, or estate channels
  • Professionals looking to monetize their network without the burden of licensing or fund management


*Charitable organizations can utilize their Capital Agent role to drive mass charitable, and social impact for their various current and future programs.


This mass individual empowerment and expansive social impact integration is a purposeful and very important component to us at Magnum, in keeping with our 125yr tradition, where democratized opportunity for all, at every socio-economic level, every geo-location in developed and under-developed nations, can raise the ‘economic base of the societal pyramid’ in every region. Where capitalism can co-exist without displacement, with equality, dignity, respect, levelling the contentious playing field between the “have’s and the have not’s”.


Commission Example (2% on capital intake from each partner capital placement with Magnum)


Raise 1,000 EU  Earn 20 EU- Micro partners/investors (global individuals)

title: Full Stack Software Engineer (LAMP)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience producing commercial-grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience and strong problem-solving abilities, quickly learn new technologies and concepts, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent. The client provides industry-leading software for environmental compliance, fuel management, and facility maintenance in the retail and commercial fuel industry. Their platform helps major fuel networks, including global brands, monitor and optimize their operations by delivering real-time insights, automating compliance tasks, and ensuring site uptime.

As a software engineer on this team, you'll have the opportunity to work on scalable cloud-based solutions that make a measurable impact on sustainability and operational efficiency in a mission-critical industry. More specifically, you will work to modernize an application that enables quick deployments into international cloud regions to support markets with data residency restrictions, provide updates, and strengthen its security posture.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance an existing LAMP-based web application to ensure continued stability and performance
  • Design and develop modern application components, including both front-end features and back-end services
  • Take technical ownership of features, contributing to both functional and technical specifications to align with business goals
  • Independently deliver high-quality product features and updates, while proactively seeking guidance when needed to maintain momentum
  • Write and execute unit tests to ensure code quality and reliability
  • Investigate and resolve defects identified during QA and user acceptance testing cycles
  • Actively participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to discuss priorities, progress, and share ideas or technical insights
  • Apply a solid understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) to projects of increasing complexity, with a focus on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • System analysis and design
  • Effort estimation
  • Sprint and release planning

Required Experience:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • 4+ years of full-stack development experience using PHP, Linux (AWS EC2), Apache, and MySQL to build and maintain production-grade, commercial web applications
  • Hands-on experience with AWS CloudFormation (infrastructure as code) and deploying containerized applications using AWS ECS (Docker)
  • Solid understanding of Agile development practices, object-oriented programming, and multi-tiered software architectures
  • Proven ability to work independently while recognizing when to collaborate or seek guidance to meet deadlines and maintain high quality
  • Strong team player with a collaborative mindset and practical communication skills
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a demonstrated ability to quickly learn new technologies and concepts
  • Adaptable and open to change, with a proactive attitude and passion for continuous improvement
  • Self-motivated, results-driven, creative, and accountable in delivering work to a high standard


Preferred Experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (a technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiarity with AWS networking concepts, including VPC design and VPN configuration.
  • Experience working with AWS SQS for decoupled, event-driven architectures and AWS S3 for object storage and data lifecycle management.


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Inside Sales Account Executive, North America
description:
Location: anywhere in LATAM


JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We are looking for dedicated sales professionals to drive adoption of our product at universities and colleges in North America. An ideal candidate is a result-oriented achiever, who is effective in a remote work environment and strives to succeed and grow with the company.


Responsibilities :


  • Own full sales cycle, from prospecting to close. Meet or exceed sales goals.
  • Craft and execute your territory sales plan & progress opportunities in the pipeline.
  • Provide product demos to researchers, teaching faculty and academic librarians in North America.
  • Proactively communicate with clients and users through emails and calls.
  • Analyze trends and make data driven decisions on priorities in your work.
  • Work effectively with other teams such as marketing to deliver on sales targets, team projects and campaigns.


Requirements :


  • A Bachelor’s degree.
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in sales, preferably in EdTech, STEM Publishing or SaaS.
  • Excellent English communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Experienced with Salesforce and platforms such as Hubspot.
  • Confidence in dealing with clients and product users.
  • Self-motivated, initiative, results-oriented and willing to learn new skills.
  • A drive to succeed and a proven ability to be resilient and overcome challenges.


Why Join JoVE?

title: Mathematics/Statics Subject Matter Expert (Master/PHD)
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider of choice for 4 out of 5 of the world’s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we’re helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany. We’re poised for a period of explosive growth over the next few years.


About the Role:


At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and curious subject matter experts.


We are seeking a Mathematics Subject Matter Expert with exceptional writing and analytical skills to join our AI/ML data team. In this role, you will help train advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) by producing, curating, and reviewing high-quality educational and technical mathematics content. Your expertise will directly shape the way AI systems understand, explain, and reason about fundamental and advanced mathematical concepts.


Key Responsibilities:


Create high-quality, accurate, and pedagogically sound content in mathematics, including:

  • Conceptual explanations
  • Problem sets and solutions
  • Theoretical summaries and derivations
  • Research abstracts and technical writing


Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to:


  • Review and refine mathematics-related model outputs
  • Identify and fill conceptual gaps in LLM training data
  • Build datasets across various mathematics domains (e.g., Algebra, Calculus, Geometry, Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Number Theory, Discrete Math, etc.)
  • Provide feedback to improve LLM performance in reasoning, solving, and communicating mathematical content


Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master's or PhD in Mathematics or a closely related discipline (MS with exceptional experience may be considered)
  • Strong background in theoretical and/or applied mathematics
  • Excellent technical and academic writing skills


As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment.

*The assessment is mandatory & non-billable*

title: Technical Project Manager  – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks
description:
We are seeking a Technical Project Manager – Core Networks /Mobile & Converged Networks with strong expertise in mobile and converged network architectures to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Nokia network solutions, virtualization technologies, and key signaling protocols, and will play a crucial role in aligning network strategies with customer and business objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support mobile networks (2G, 3G, 4G, and 5G) and fixed/converged network architectures.
  • Manage and optimize virtualized environments using Nokia CBIS VMs , containers (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms such as NCS.
  • Work with Nokia network elements and third-party systems including CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, and CSD .
  • Troubleshoot and optimize signaling protocols such as SIP, Diameter, and S7 .
  • Lead cross-functional teams to deliver network solutions aligned with customer and Nokia objectives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and project risks effectively.
  • Provide deep analytical support and troubleshoot complex network issues.


Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Extensive knowledge of mobile network technologies (2G, 3G, 4G, 5G), fixed and converged networks.
  • Experience with virtualization and container platforms (Nokia CBIS , Docker , Kubernetes , NCS ).
  • Familiarity with Nokia network components (CMM, CMG, CNCS, Titan, HSS/HLR, CSD ) and third-party solutions.
  • Strong understanding of SIP, Diameter, and S7 protocols.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively with customers and internal stakeholders to meet technical and business goals.
  • Excellent risk management, leadership, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting aptitude.
  • Proficiency in English.

P

referred Qualifications

  • Certifications or relevant education in Telecommunications, Networking, or related fields.
  • Prior experience working with Nokia systems and large-scale network deployments.
