title: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Ciência da Medição Pleno



Resumo:

Pessoa será responsável por garantir a manutenção dos produtos e processos correntes, atuando também continuamente em busca de melhorias metodológicas, processuais e em qualidade. Além disso, se posiciona como ponto focal para atendimento de dúvidas dos times de Produto, Operações e Comercial, suportando também testes, documentações e estudos de novos processos.




O que você irá fazer:

  • Promover a contínua comunicação com os principais stakeholders internos para a manutenção dos critérios técnicos na sustentabilidade dos processos recorrentes nos produtos.
  • Garantir em metodologia e execução a manutenção de processos já validados e em operação nos produtos em que o time possui atuação.
  • Atuar nas inclusões, revisões e atualizações metodológicas propostas pelo time e/ou demandadas por Produto e Comercial dos processos relacionados com métodos de integração de dados para os produtos do Portfólio.
  • Mapear, desenvolver e apoiar o desenvolvimento de análises e testes de novos processos dos produtos de Audiência de TV e Cross Media.
  • Propor e desenvolver controles de qualidade com o objetivo de garantir e certificar o pleno funcionamento de etapas de processos internos e/ou externos associados aos produtos e cobertos pelo escopo do time.
  • Mapear oportunidades em que a automação pode promover melhora significativa na qualidade e/ ou eficiência de processos.
  • Propor e desenvolver técnicas e aplicações de automação para atividades recorrentes na equipe ou executadas por áreas de interface e que impactem os processos da equipe.
  • Monitorar de forma contínua o mercado de Inteligência Artificial, com objetivo de identificar e implementar soluções que visem inovação, melhoria e/ou eficiência.
  • Fomentar de forma constante a inovação e melhoria contínua em temas relacionados à área, estando constantemente ativo na busca e curadoria de novas práticas e aberto a ouvir propostas de outros membros da equipe.
  • Contribuir para o crescimento de cada membro da equipe, estando sempre disponível para troca de ideias, explicações e compartilhamento de conhecimento.




O que buscamos?

  • Formação Superior em Estatística, Matemática ou áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável experiência na indústria de publicidade e/ou mídia.
  • Fundamental experiência em linguagens de programação como Python e R.
  • Desejável conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados integradas ao Python, R ou como o Power BI.
  • Desejável conhecimento em plataformas para uso de dados em nuvem, como Azure Databricks.
  • Desejável conhecimento e interesse em soluções acionáveis de Inteligência Artificial para negócios e dados.
  • Inglês intermediário fundamental, para leitura, escrita e conversação.
  • Espanhol desejável.




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias

description:
Especialista em Soluções de Engenharia (Vendas) | Home Office | CIM-Team (Vaga para residentes em Porto Alegre ou Região Metropolitana)


Descrição: A CIM-Team busca um(a) Engenheiro(a) com perfil comercial para uma posição estratégica: ser a autoridade técnica e comercial do E3.series, o software de engenharia elétrica de ponta usado por mais de 40 mil engenheiros no mundo.

Seu papel vai além da venda. Você será o especialista que visita (mesmo que virtualmente) grandes indústrias, entende seus gargalos de engenharia e apresenta soluções de alto impacto.


Suas responsabilidades-chave:

  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vendas de A a Z (prospecção, demonstração técnica, negociação e fechamento).
  • Atuar como consultor(a) técnico(a) para clientes no Brasil e América Latina.
  • Ser a ponte técnica direta com os desenvolvedores na Alemanha (Zuken).
  • Gerenciar sua carteira e sucesso de clientes via HubSpot.


O candidato(a) ideal:

  • Engenheiro(a) Eletricista ou de Automação.
  • Já atuou em áreas comerciais (vendas técnicas, pré-vendas, aplicação).
  • Comunica-se bem em inglês (nível técnico).
  • Reside em Porto Alegre ou Região Metropolitana
  • Diferencial de Ouro: Possui formação técnica (Eletrotécnica, Automação, etc.) pré-universitária.
  • Bônus: Fala espanhol.


O que oferecemos:

  • A solidez de uma contratação CLT com a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto.
  • Todo o equipamento necessário para seu home office.
  • Pacote completo de benefícios (Plano de Saúde, Odonto, VA/VR, Auxílio Home Office).
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com tecnologia de ponta e clientes de renome mundial.


Se você é movido por desafios técnicos e quer crescer em uma empresa líder, queremos conhecer você.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: Architect
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an Architecture Lead to drive the design and execution of brand experiences, pop-ups, permanent retail spaces, and large-scale installations. This role merges creative vision with technical expertise, bridging design, production, and fabrication to deliver exceptional innovative environments. You'll lead projects from concept through construction, providing strategic direction, coordinating cross-disciplinary teams, and serving as the key liaison between creative leadership, production, and fabrication partners.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously
  • Drive design development from initial concept through detailed construction documentation
  • Establish and maintain design standards, ensuring high-quality, innovative, and functional outcomes
  • Collaborate with producers and project managers to maintain project timelines, milestones, and deliverables
  • Partner with creative directors to understand design intent and translate it into clear architectural strategies
  • Generate daily creative briefs to guide the architecture design team on project direction and next steps
  • Provide real-time feedback, guidance, and mentorship to junior architectural designers throughout the design process
  • Communicate and present complex design ideas clearly to both creative and technical stakeholders
  • Develop precise schematic drawing packages and 3D models in Rhinoceros for vendor and fabricator coordination
  • Ensure all drawings and designs comply with relevant codes, standards, and regulations for domestic and international markets
  • Collaborate directly with engineers, fabricators, and contractors to identify optimal solutions for project execution
  • Review and approve shop drawings and fabrication details prior to production
  • Research, review, and specify appropriate materials and finishes
  • Provide construction oversight to ensure design intent is maintained throughout on-site execution


REQUIREMENTS

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture
  • 8+ years of professional experience in architecture, with proven leadership in design-driven projects
  • Experience with retail, set design, exhibitions, or experiential installations
  • Strong understanding of materials, construction methods, and fabrication processes
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in creating technical drawings and specifications
  • Excellent leadership, organizational, and communication skills
  • Portfolio demonstrating design excellence and ability to work on projects at different scales
  • Ability to manage fast-paced projects and adapt quickly to shifting priorities
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a team
  • Professional knowledge and use of Rhinoceros is mandatory
  • Proficient in Google Docs suite (Docs, Slides, Spreadsheet)
  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign)
  • Ability to quickly learn Cinema 4D and Octane rendering software



ABOUT DE-YAN

DE-YAN is a brand experience studio built to lead the next era of human connection.

We seamlessly fuse creative development, in-house production, and immersive storytelling to create authentic, human-first moments – moments that are proven to build a powerful relationship between brands and their audiences.


With deep roots in fashion, luxury, beauty, and lifestyle, DE-YAN balances concept and craft to create innovative, experience-led creative across five key disciplines: Experiential Design, Motion, Creative Technology, Graphic Design, and Physical Production - all rooted in Creative Strategy and a deep understanding of culture. Our global team of 120+ full-time creatives spans New York, Los Angeles, EU, Brazil, and Canada, allowing us to bring diverse perspectives and rigorous precision to every brief.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

As a Software Engineer focused on Artificial Intelligence, you will make a significant contribution to the construction of innovative AI Agents by collaborating closely with your engineering peers. This role requires a high degree of creative thinking and a strong willingness to learn, as you will be working with the latest in Generative AI tools and frameworks. The Agentic AI Engineer explores emerging technologies, promotes new development approaches, and helps shape the standards for intelligent automation, playing a fundamental role in advancing the company's AI-driven solutions.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of autonomous AI Agents, leveraging LLMs, advanced techniques such as RAG, and agent-specific frameworks;
  • Develop full-stack applications that support and interact with AI Agents, using JavaScript/TypeScript, React, and Next.js to build the necessary interfaces and systems;
  • Explore and experiment with emerging technologies and frameworks in the agentic space, fostering innovation and shaping best practices;
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to define the behavior, capabilities, and goals of AI Agents, translating business requirements into robust agentic solutions;
  • Ensure code quality through rigorous reviews, testing, and documentation, while mentoring other engineers on development best practices.


Essential Skills

  • Solid experience in software engineering, with proven expertise in writing clean, maintainable code and leveraging modern CI/CD pipelines to ensure quality and automate delivery;
  • Hands-on and up-to-date knowledge of Generative AI, including experience building and implementing features with LLMs in real-world products;
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles, including system design, API architecture, code quality, and testing.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience in designing GenAI solutions architecture, agent frameworks, and advanced techniques such as RAG;
  • Knowledge of Natural Language Processing (NLP) applied to production-grade systems;
  • Hands-on experience with Agentic AI, including proficiency with modern frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or CrewAI for the purpose of building, testing, and deploying autonomous, goal-oriented agents.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Staff Frontend Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.


We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team is focused on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.

  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.

  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.

  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.

  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.

  • Demonstrates proficiency in various UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.

  • A proven expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on applying comprehensive typing throughout the stack to deliver maintainable and highly reliable user experiences.

  • Proficiency in breaking down product documents and abstracts into well-defined feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.

  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and in working with Figma and internal design systems.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (


Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products delivering intuitive experiences for our customers while also enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsabilities:

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.

  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.

  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.

  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.

  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.

  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.

  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.

  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.

  • Demonstrates strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience balancing trade-offs between technical debt, speed, and long-term scalability in a way that advances organizational goals.

title: Analista de Customer Success
description:
Estamos em busca de talentos que queiram crescer junto com a transformação digital.


Se você é movido por desafios, quer se desenvolver profissionalmente em um ambiente dinâmico, tem paixão por criar relacionamentos e interesse genuíno em tecnologia e inovação, essa pode ser a sua próxima grande oportunidade.


Com a rápida evolução das soluções em nuvem e a transformação constante do mercado de tecnologia, o modelo de vendas mudou — e isso exige profissionais adaptáveis, curiosos e dispostos a aprender continuamente. Procuramos Analista de Customer Success com mentalidade de crescimento, que valorizem a construção de relacionamentos, saibam trabalhar em equipe e consigam tratar cada cliente de maneira única e especial.


Você fará parte de um time ágil, focado em resultados e altamente colaborativo.


Se você quer aprender, se desenvolver e crescer em uma empresa que acompanha as mudanças do mercado, envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente.


Vale a pena conhecer a vaga!


Responsabilidades:


  • Ser resolutivo (a) com os eventuais conflitos em clientes;
  • Entender e conduzir de forma amigável os atendimentos;
  • Estabelecer ótimo relacionamento com os clientes;
  • Análise de números, elaboração de gráficos;
  • Responsável por entender o nível de sucesso dos clientes;
  • Apoio e suporte ao time de vendas.


Qualificações básicas:


  • Gostar de desafios;
  • Amar relacionamento com clientes;
  • Ser excelente ouvinte;
  • Ter bom controle emocional;
  • Experiência prévia como Assistente de Customer Success em empresas de software;
  • Totalmente comprometido com as metas e resultados;
  • Treinável e flexível às mudanças (durante o projeto, será provável a necessidade de novas técnicas, novos produtos, e novas abordagens);
  • Fortemente auto motivável;
  • Facilidade e gosto em conversas telefônicas – uma parte importante do trabalho será reuniões remotas com clientes;
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de Customer Success;
  • Pensamento criativo;
  • Empatia (fundamental para esse trabalho);
  • Que seja proativo para trabalhar sozinho buscando seus próprios resultados independente de ajuda e necessidade de supervisão;
  • Saber trabalhar com ferramentas do Office: Word, Excel, Outlook e PowerPoint;
  • Habilidade em conhecer novos métodos de trabalho. Necessidade de entender e aplicar a forma de trabalho da empresa.


Qualificações preferidas não obrigatórias:


  • Nível superior
  • Boas noções Comerciais (Área de Vendas) e/ou Relacionamento com clientes (Customer Success)
  • Conhecimento nas ferramentas colaborativas Microsoft.


Experiências prévias desejadas:


  • Atuação em área de Customer Success, mínimo 6 meses.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno
description:
DESENVOLVEDOR JAVA BACKEND PLENO


A G4F é uma empresa com uma trajetória sólida de 15 anos, dedicada a conectar pessoas, ideias e tecnologia para oferecer soluções inovadoras. Somos mais de 8.000 #greaters atuando em todo o Brasil.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em curso de nível superior na área de Tecnologia da Informação; OU
  • Conclusão de qualquer curso de nível superior acompanhado de certificado de curso de pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia da Informação.


Obrigatório

  • Experiência exercendo atividades como desenvolvedores de aplicações Java EE 6+ com Springboot.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações para pelo menos um dos servidores:

* Apache Tomcat;

* JBoss/Wildfly;

* Open Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server Liberty;

* WebSphere Application Server versão 8 ou superior.


  • Noções ou familiaridade com APIS REST
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e POO
  • Conhecimento de padrão de projeto, qualidade de código, boas práticas
  • Conhecimentos em SOLID
  • Conhecimentos em JPA


Desejável

  • Certificação CSD - Certified Scrum Developer.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos baseados em Metodologia Ágil, adotando requisitos ágeis e histórias do usuário.
  • Experiência na técnica Acceptance Test Driven Development (ATDD) usando Cucumber ou equivalente.
  • Experiência em análise e tunning de performance de aplicações em servidores WebSphere Application Server.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações que utilizem portlets, JSF (Primefaces) ou React.
  • Experiência no uso das seguintes ferramentas IBM DB2, MS SQL Server, IBM Websphere MQ, Apache Maven e Gradle.

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Performance Web Front-End apaixonado(a) por otimizar a velocidade, a responsividade e a experiência do usuário das nossas aplicações web. O foco principal é garantir o carregamento ultrarrápido das páginas, melhorar as métricas de Core Web Vitals e aplicar as melhores práticas de SEO Técnico, resultando em melhor posicionamento nos mecanismos de busca e aumento nas taxas de conversão.


Principais Responsabilidades

1. Otimização de Performance:

- Analisar, diagnosticar e solucionar gargalos de performance no Front-End (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, imagens, fontes).

- Focar na melhoria contínua das métricas Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) e outras métricas de velocidade (TTFB, FCP, TTI).

- Implementar técnicas de otimização como code splitting, lazy loading, pré-carregamento de recursos (preloading/prefetching), compressão (Gzip/Brotli) e caching avançado.

2. SEO Técnico e Carregamento:

- Garantir a rastreabilidade (crawlability) e indexação eficiente das páginas por bots de mecanismos de busca.

- Otimizar a estrutura do DOM, o uso de HTML semântico e metatags.

- Trabalhar na renderização ideal (server-side, client-side ou híbrida/SSR) para equilibrar performance e SEO.

3. Monitoramento e Análise:

-Utilizar ferramentas como Google PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, WebPageTest, Google Search Console e ferramentas de RUM (Real User Monitoring) para monitorar e reportar a performance em ambientes de produção.

-Criar e manter dashboards de performance, identificando tendências e oportunidades de otimização.

4. Colaboração e Educação:

-Colaborar de perto com equipes de Design (UX/UI), Back-End e Marketing/SEO para garantir que as novas funcionalidades sejam lançadas com alta performance e aderência técnica.

-Definir padrões de desenvolvimento e atuar como um mentor técnico, disseminando a cultura de performance para toda a equipe de Front-End.


Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais (Hard Skills)


• Proficiência em: HTML semântico, CSS (incluindo pré-processadores ou CSS-in-JS) e JavaScript moderno (ES6+).

• Domínio de Frameworks/Bibliotecas: Experiência avançada em pelo menos um dos principais frameworks de Front-End (React, Vue.js ou Angular), com foco na otimização de builds e carregamento.

• Otimização de Assets: Conhecimento profundo em otimização de imagens (WebP, AVIF, tag), font loading (FOIT, FOUT) e minificação de código.

• Ferramentas de Build/Bundling: Experiência com ferramentas como Webpack, Rollup ou Vite, configurando otimizações para produção.

• Infraestrutura/Rede: Entendimento de redes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3), Content Delivery Networks (CDN) e estratégias de cache no navegador e no servidor.

• SEO Técnico: Conhecimento em Sitemap, Robots.txt, canonicalização, dados estruturados (Schema.org) e experiências de usuário mobile.


Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills)


• Foco em Resultados: Orientação clara para melhorias mensuráveis (KPIs) de performance e SEO.

• Resolução de Problemas Complexos: Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas que atravessam múltiplas camadas (navegador, rede, servidor, código).

• Comunicação: Habilidade para explicar problemas técnicos complexos e as soluções propostas para audiências não técnicas (marketing, gestão).

• Aprendizado Contínuo: Manter-se atualizado com as constantes mudanças nos algoritmos de busca e nas tecnologias de otimização web.


Diferenciais

• Experiência com SSR (Server-Side Rendering) ou SSG (Static Site Generation) usando frameworks como Next.js ou Nuxt.js.

• Conhecimento de PWA (Progressive Web Apps) e estratégias offline-first.

Experiência em plataformas de Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) para otimizar o deployment e a entrega.

- GOOGLE CORE WEB VITALS

- LCP

- CLS

- TTFB

- GOOGLE LIGHTHOUSE

- DASHBOARDS DE PERFORMANCE

- DESIGN DE EXPERIENCIA DO USUARIO (UX/UI)

- DESENVOLVIMENTO COM NEXT.JS

- Nuxt.js

- PWA (PROGRESSIVE WEB APPS)

- ADMINISTRACAO DA CLOUD AWS

- PROCESSAMENTO DE SITEMAPS

- DATADOG RUM (REAL USER MONITORING)


Habilidades Comportamentais:

- Resolução de problemas complexos

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Mid/Senior)
description:
Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a versatile Full-Stack Engineer to join our team. While we’re primarily seeking professionals comfortable working across the stack, from building Vue.js + TypeScript interfaces to developing Kotlin/Spring Boot APIs with PostgreSQL, we also welcome candidates with strong Frontend or Backend experience who are eager to collaborate in a full-stack environment.


What you will do :

Mid-Level Engineers

title: Brazil | SRE, Java & .NET Engineers (Remote)
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


Our mission is to be a meaningful part of our people's careers. As we grow, so does our determination to offer the best experience to our employees and clients — and that’s exactly what drives us. We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with offices in Lisbon, Porto and Óbidos, and representations in Brazil and Tunisia. We have over 12 years of market expertise, and today we are a universe of around 400 people working on-site, remotely or in hybrid mode in projects across 20+ countries.


We believe that great people make successful companies, and that’s why we stand for the appreciation, recognition and growth of our professionals.


We don’t want to be just another line on your CV — we want you to live a Lifetime Experience with us. We invest in training and certifications that confirm your real progression, in promoting a healthy work-life balance, and in offering benefits that impact your personal life and career.


#welcometoyourfuture

Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)

– 4 to 6 years of experience

– Strong knowledge in DevOps and Operations

– Experience with monitoring, CI/CD, cloud , and system reliability practices


⚙️ Java Engineer

– 4 to 6 years of experience in Java development

– Interest in learning new technologies , such as Python

– Experience with integration, APIs, testing, and troubleshooting

title: Administrative Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Operations Admin to support our Central Operations team and US Operations markets in general administrative tasks and onboarding growth. If you are a well organized, analytical person with exceptional communication and problem solving skills then this role may be for you!



What You’ll Focus On:

  • Support our US Operations Cities on growth deliverables and efficiencies in our day to day work and operations
  • Automations for our ways of working when it comes to growth and portfolio changes
  • Analyze data in order to create and prepare detailed reports for the leadership team that effectively communicate trends, patterns, and predictions using relevant data
  • Standardize our ways of working across markets to improve timeliness and execution on furnishings and move-outs
  • Perform audits and improve data metrics for our guests and internal teams, as well as manage timely data collection to update productivity and achievements on projects
  • Unit/Building/Process information entry, ensuring all fields are accurately filled and clear for other teams
  • Collaborate with operational team members and organizational leaders to identify gaps and opportunities for process improvements
  • Communicate with third party vendors and companies if needed to support OPS/CX operations
  • Specific admin support related to onboarding and move-out of units for our US cities including:
  • Complete utility and telecommunication setups for new units with third party companies (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Complete Package Setups for new units (create online portals, set up payments, and input data into our internal system)
  • Cancel utility and telecommunication accounts for move-outs
  • Support the scheduling of furnishing and onboarding tasks and move-outs:
  • Communicate with third party vendors and buildings to schedule pick ups
  • Input data into our system related to our properties
  • Track disposal and data related to move-outs
  • Support Central Operations, OPS local team, and finance/accounting with ad-hoc projects



What we are looking for:

  • Degree from a top-tier university
  • Min. 1-2 years of experience in a similar role (administrative experience in residential or hospitality experience will be considered as a plus)
  • Fluency in English
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (formulation, data entry, charts, pivot tables) and Powerpoint
  • Self-starter with a roll up your sleeves mentality and high attention to detail
  • Entrepreneurial drive, adaptability, and focus on results
  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and with speed

title: Legal Assistant
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant for Law Firms


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Assistant for Law Firms


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:

title: Network Security Specialist, Enterprise Browser
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

You will join an exciting and high growth business unit with Palo Alto Networks positioning the industry’s most comprehensive SASE security platform, with the industry’s broadest security and compliance coverage for applications used by your hybrid workforce, regardless of whether they are at home, on the go, or in the office.

In this role, you will be responsible for managing a territory focusing on Major, Strategic, and Enterprise Accounts. Working closely with Palo Alto business partners and driving sales for our Enterprise Browser security solution, into new and existing customers. It is expected that you deliver or exceed your sales targets in both new business and renewals for ACV and TCV bookings. The role expects you to define your territory, strategies and then lead local execution and in alignment to company strategies and tactics within the Prisma SASE organization.

Your Impact

  • Win new logos, renew existing customer and expand business within your territory
  • Achieve ACV sales quotas on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Present regular/accurate forecasting for review
  • Track and report on all opportunities, pipeline, and bookings to provide forecast reports to region management
  • Establish relationships and engage with the local reseller and alliance partners on sales programs and joint activities
  • Develop, share and implement standard methodologies and

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.

  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment

title: Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Senior Microsoft Teams Specialist who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:


Administer and optimize Microsoft Teams, including channels, policies, integrations, and APIs.

Automate processes and recommend engineering improvements.

Monitor alerts, analyze root causes, and implement solutions.

Work with PowerShell, MS Graph, and application management in Teams.

Test new features and implement changes securely.

What we're looking for:

Strong experience with Microsoft Teams, M365, and integrations.

Proficiency in PowerShell/MS Graph.

Experience managing applications, APIs, and automation.

Knowledge of RCA (Root Cause Analysis) and service improvement.

Fluent in English


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

  • Health insurance

  • Life insurance

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Back-end Java Pleno 100% Remoto
description:
Qual o tamanho dos seus objetivos? Deseja novos desafios?


Então, vem para TQI!


A TQI é uma empresa de tecnologia e inovação que há mais de 30 anos, desenvolve soluções para suportar e alavancar os negócios de seus clientes no Brasil e no exterior.

Com escritórios em Uberlândia (MG) e em São Paulo (SP), e colaboradores em centenas de cidades, a TQI conquistou e mantém há mais de 6 anos o selo Great Place to Work (GPTW), e está no ranking 80+ do GPTW de Tecnologia, reforçando seu compromisso para promover um ambiente diverso e propício para inovação e alta performance.


Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Modelo de contrato: CLT


O que procuramos:

  • Superior em Tecnologia da Informação (ou áreas correlatas) ou experiência relevante;
  • Conhecimento em estrutura de dados e paradigma de programação orientada a objetos;
  • Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e microserviços;
  • Experiência com linguagem de programação Java/Kotlin;
  • Experiência com framework Spring (Boot, Data, Cloud, etc);
  • Experiência com Git, Gradle/Maven e ferramentas de CI/CD;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais como Oracle;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de API REST;
  • Experiência com comunicação assíncrona utilizando brokers (RabbitMQ, JMS, Kafka, etc);
  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de monitoração de sistemas como New Relic, Grafana, ELK, etc;
  • Experiência com automação de testes;
  • Conhecimento em AWS.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Avaliar, discutir e contribuir com a definição da arquitetura de sistemas;
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em arquiteturas e sistemas;
  • Analisar, documentar, codificar, revisar código, depurar, testar e entregar aplicações;
  • Cuidar da monitoração do ambiente e criar ações proativas que garantam a saúde da plataforma;
  • Interagir com equipes e áreas correlatas;
  • Contribuir com melhorias de processos da engenharia.


O que oferecemos:


Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.

Você fará parte de equipes diversas e de alto performance, em um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo. Valorizamos a contribuição de todos na criação de soluções e nas decisões estratégicas. Aqui, as pessoas são o nosso diferencial, e somos apaixonados por tecnologia, inovação e evolução contínua.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S. , serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus . We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in LATAM. This position is remote. The candidate will be responsible for managing various areas of our backend platform, including API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and partners.


As a Backend Engineer with our Enterprise Tribe you will play a central role in helping Rain become the #1 platform for financial wellness by focusing on data integration, data ingestion, and payroll processing. You will work with our product and engineering teams to provide financial freedom to over 1 million employees by managing the data ingestion of over 10 million timekeeping records per day. Our ideal candidate is excited to tackle tough technical challenges and looking for opportunities to contribute to our strategic thinking.


Responsibilities:

  • Translate product requirements into robust technical solutions, recommend alternative approaches and lead engineering efforts to meet ambitious targets
  • Design and implement reliable systems and applications in the context of a fully distributed micro-services architecture
  • Build and maintain integrations with 3rd-party vendors and partners
  • Design and implement highly available RESTful APIs supporting user-facing web and mobile applications
  • Focus on creating reusable code and libraries that can be shared across teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring scalability for future projects.
  • Enforce observability best practices, leveraging tools like logging, metrics and alerting systems
  • Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for all solutions, including architecture designs, APIs, workflows, and system configurations.
  • Continuously monitor Rain systems and applications for opportunities to maximize performance and scalability
  • Effective cross-team communication and collaboration to align priorities, clarify requirements, identify dependencies, and ensure seamless coordination throughout the software development lifecycle.


Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Software Development experience
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent combination of technical education and
  • work experience.
  • Proficient knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Go / Golang, Java, Python and C++
  • Strong expertise in designing and developing RESTful APIs
  • Experience with both SQL and NoSQL database technologies and strong understanding of database concepts and internals, including data model design and optimization principles
  • Experience at building reliable and scalable user-facing applications
  • Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable distributed systems and microservices architectures, with a strong ability to meet performance and scalability requirements
  • Excellent collaboration skills, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams, present ideas, and communicate technical concepts clearly
  • Keep up to date with technologies - AWS/Azure/GCP, serverless, Docker, Kubernetes, ECS among others
  • Strong ability to take ownership of projects, driving initiatives from concept to completion with minimal supervision, while proactively identifying challenges and solutions.
  • Experience working with agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban, to deliver high-quality results in iterative cycles
  • Proficiency in message queuing systems such as Kafka(preferred)/RabbitMQ/Flink.
  • Effective release management experience for ensuring zero downtime and experience with CI/CD frameworks such as Gitlab CI and Github actions



As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, Rain is committed to Equal Employment Opportunity and does not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sex (including pregnancy), protected veteran status, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or any unlawful criterion existing under applicable federal, state, or local laws. title: Desenvolvedor FullStackPleno(Angular/Java) | Aceitação PJ | Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoa com Deficiência
description:
Sobre o PicPay


Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop.

Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.


Conheça melhor a unidade de negócio que essa vaga pertence:

Nossa unidade PicPay Negócios , tem a missão de simplificar a vida de "quem vende alguma coisa". Da grande empresa ao pequeno empreendedor. Por aqui, você fará parte da construção e desenvolvimento de produtos e serviços que simplificam a vida de milhões de brasileiros e empresas.


Sobre a vaga:

Estamos buscando uma pessoa desenvolvedora Pleno com experiência em Angular para contribuir no desenvolvimento de soluções móveis modernas e escaláveis. Procuramos alguém que goste de desafios, valorize boas práticas e esteja comprometido(a) com a entrega de produtos de alta qualidade.


Responsabilidade e atribuições


  • Atuar como um desenvolvedor mobile dentro da Squad, sendo responsável pela entrega de código com qualidade e de acordo com os requisitos de negócio;
  • Participar do discovery e desenho de soluções das novas features, junto com o time de produto e designers;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com o restante da equipe, composta por backends e frontends;
  • Dividir com os demais desenvolvedores a responsabilidade na realização dos testes para validação das features entregues no ambiente de QA;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com outros times, compartilhando conhecimento, melhores práticas e propor soluções que atendam os objetivos negócio;
  • Manter documentações das soluções.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência em Desenvolvimento Web (Angular ) e Backend (Java ou Kotlin);
  • Conhecimento sólido em tecnologias para desenvolvimento web front-end (JavaScript, HTML e CSS);
  • Conhecimento de programação reativa (RxJS) e gerenciamento de estado (Akita);
  • Conhecimento de testes unitários (JestJS);
  • Capacidade, experiência e entusiasmo para atuar de maneira generalista de acordo com a necessidade do time;
  • Atenção para qualidade de código e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Conhecimento de Banco de Dados relacionais;
  • Familiaridade com controle de versão usando Git, testes unitários e metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil.


Será considerado um diferencial


  • Conhecimento de patterns CSS: B.E.M, SMACSS, etc;
  • Experiência com NestJS;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em BFF;
  • Domínio de Arquitetura de Micro-serviços;
  • Conhecimento de Banco de Dados não relacionais;
  • Conhecimentos em AWS;


O que oferecemos:


Saúde e Bem-estar

  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Programa Lado a Lado, com apoio jurídico, social, psicológico e financeiro;
  • TotalPass.

Alimentação/ Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho:

  • Cartão de crédito PicPay Benefícios , com ampla aceitação, onde você recebe seu saldo de Alimentação/Refeição e Mobilidade ou Teletrabalho (de acordo com o seu contrato de trabalho).

Licença Paternidade e Maternidade:

  • Licença Maternidade estendida de 6 meses, e de Paternidade também estendida de 20 dias.
  • Programa "Novo Ser", que acompanha nossas mamães durante toda a gestação e no retorno da licença. Falando nisso, ao retornar da licença maternidade, as mamães ainda contam com a ajuda do Auxílio Creche e também os papais que possuem guarda unilateral ou compartilhada.

Reconhecemos resultados: PPR- Participação nos Resultados do PicPay.


#VemserPicpayLover #Picpay #LI-REMOTE #LI-SS1

title: M365 Consultant
description:
English-speaking Microsoft 365 Consultant


$3,500 – $5,000 USD/month

Fully Remote

Full-time, long-term contract

Excellent English skills required for this position


About the Company

Join a US-based Cloud Expert MSP delivering enterprise-grade Microsoft 365, Azure, and multi-cloud solutions to global clients.

Their teams help organizations secure, optimize, and modernize their Microsoft ecosystems — improving collaboration, compliance, and operational efficiency across M365, Azure, and hybrid environments.


You’ll be part of a specialist Microsoft 365 Center of Excellence, working alongside senior engineers and consultants who design, implement, and manage advanced enterprise environments.

This is a long-term remote opportunity to grow your career in a world-class Microsoft ecosystem — with exposure to architecture, automation, governance, and continuous service improvement.


The Role

As a Microsoft 365 Consultant, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of operational, architectural, administrative, and consultative responsibilities across enterprise M365 environments.

This is a hands-on engineering and advisory position — blending technical depth with strategic consulting. You’ll work directly with enterprise clients to keep their Microsoft 365 ecosystems secure, compliant, cost-efficient, and aligned with evolving business needs.

You’ll work on:


  • Leading monthly environment reviews and recommending strategic improvements
  • (Secure Score, license optimization, usage insights, product roadmap updates)
  • Designing and maintaining Microsoft 365 architectures aligned with Microsoft best practices
  • Configuring and deploying M365 services (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune, etc.)
  • Monitoring service health, telemetry, and usage to proactively resolve issues
  • Performing incident, request, and change management activities
  • Contributing to documentation including configuration designs and operational procedures
  • Collaborating in change control, adoption, and stabilization meetings
  • Coordinating with Microsoft Support when escalations are required


This is not a traditional support role — you’ll engage directly with customers, provide insights on modernization, and shape the future of their Microsoft 365 environments.


What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years’ experience in Microsoft 365 administration, engineering, or consulting
  • Hands-on expertise in Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Strong understanding of governance, compliance, and security best practices in M365
  • Experience managing and optimizing Microsoft licensing, consumption, and usage reporting
  • Familiarity with PowerShell scripting, automation, and M365 monitoring tools
  • Ability to conduct environmental health checks and present improvement recommendations
  • Experience working in a customer-facing or MSP environment
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills


Who You Are

  • A trusted Microsoft 365 specialist who loves solving complex technical challenges
  • A consultative communicator comfortable advising enterprise clients directly
  • A self-starter who can manage multiple customer environments independently
  • A continuous learner, always keeping up with new Microsoft releases and best practices
  • A team player who thrives in a high-performing, collaborative culture


Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Work fully remote from anywhere
  • Competitive pay: $4,000 – $5,500 USD/month
  • Long-term engagement with enterprise US clients
  • Focus on certification and career growth (Microsoft exams covered every 6 months)
  • Exposure to advanced Microsoft environments and governance frameworks
  • Collaborative, senior-level culture — no micromanagement, no bureaucracy

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 60+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Roles we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Business Analyst
  • Data Analyst
  • Data Scientist

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;

title: Consultor(a) SAP PLM
description:
Sobre a Motivus


Na Motivus, acreditamos em liberar o potencial humano por meio de soluções inovadoras e de ponta. Com mais de 1.600 colaboradores em 5 países, oferecemos um amplo espectro de serviços de software e soluções digitais. Nossas equipes são dedicadas a impulsionar a sustentabilidade, expandir os limites da tecnologia e construir a próxima geração de soluções digitais de classe mundial que capacitam nossos clientes e geram impacto duradouro. Ao se juntar à nossa equipe, você trabalhará com profissionais visionários comprometidos em criar soluções inovadoras que moldam o futuro da indústria.


Visão Geral da Posição


Estamos em busca de um(a) Consultor(a) SAP PLM para se juntar à nossa equipe. Nesse cargo, você será responsável por liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA, atuando no desenho e implementação de soluções SAP PLM otimizadas. Irá analisar processos existentes, configurar módulos como DMS e ECM, garantir integrações entre PLM e outros módulos SAP, além de definir estratégias de migração e conduzir testes funcionais. Você colaborará com equipes diversificadas, incentivará a comunicação multifuncional e contribuirá para projetos que terão um impacto significativo em nossos clientes e na indústria.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar migrações do ECC para o S/4HANA dentro do domínio PLM.
  • Analisar os processos PLM existentes no ECC e projetar soluções otimizadas para o S/4HANA.
  • Configurar módulos SAP PLM, incluindo Document Management System (DMS), Engineering Change Management (ECM), Product Structure Management e Recipe/Formulation Management.
  • Garantir a integração entre PLM e outros módulos (MM, PP, SD, QM).
  • Definir estratégia de migração, mapeamento e regras de transformação.
  • Elaborar especificações funcionais e colaborar com as equipes ABAP e Basis para desenvolvimentos customizados.
  • Apoiar atividades de migração de dados, validações e reconciliações.
  • Executar testes unitários, testes de integração e apoiar o UAT (User Acceptance Test) com os usuários-chave do negócio.
  • Fornecer suporte funcional e resolver incidentes durante e após a migração.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.
  • Seguir metodologias SAP (ASAP, Activate, Agile) durante a execução dos projetos.


Qualificações


  • Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Consultor SAP PLM.
  • Experiência prática em projetos de migração ECC → S/4HANA.
  • Sólido conhecimento em DMS, ECM e integrações de processos PLM.
  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT).
  • Inglês avançado ou superior.
  • Espanhol intermediário ou superior.
  • Conhecimento de aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de migração de dados (LTMC, LSMW, SAP Migration Cockpit).
  • Familiaridade com SAP Solution Manager para documentação e testes.
  • Fortes habilidades analíticas e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de atuar em equipes internacionais e multifuncionais.


Por Que Se Juntar a Nós?


  • Desenvolva sua Carreira: Na Motivus, você terá a oportunidade de expandir suas habilidades e assumir cargos de liderança em projetos diversificados.
  • Trabalhe com Tecnologias Emergentes: Esteja na vanguarda da inovação, trabalhando com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta.
  • Ambiente Colaborativo: Trabalhe com equipes talentosas que valorizam suas ideias e contribuições.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Oferecemos uma variedade de programas de L&D para ajudá-lo(a) a progredir em sua carreira.
  • Abordagem Centrada no Cliente: Contribua para soluções que criam valor duradouro para clientes globais da Fortune 500.


Nossos Valores


  • Cultura de Inovação: Buscamos incessantemente a inovação, incentivando nossas equipes a explorar novas ideias e tecnologias.
  • Responsabilidade: Devolvemos às comunidades que nos apoiam e aos nossos clientes.
  • Aprendizado e Desenvolvimento: Nossos colaboradores lideram, aprendem e crescem, apoiando a si mesmos e a nossos clientes.


Como se Candidatar


Os(as) candidatos(as) interessados(as) podem se inscrever enviando seu currículo e carta de apresentação para ou através de deste anúncio.


A Motivus é um empregador que promove a igualdade de oportunidades e incentiva a diversidade e inclusão no local de trabalho.

title: Estagiário de Contas a Receber
description:
Atividades:

  • Prestar suporte nas alterações nas descrições das faturas a fim de atender as especificações normativas do cliente;
  • Realizar cancelamento da fatura de pessoa jurídica/física;
  • Apoiar no controle e cadastro das bolsas de descontos no sistema, visando atender os setores requisitantes na divulgação e captação de clientes;
  • Realizar o processo de Cobrança de clientes pessoa Jurídica;
  • Apoiar na análise financeira do aluno que solicitou transferência de turma ou matrícula com dispensa de disciplinas;
  • Gerar boleto para os alunos que contrataram o curso após o faturamento da turma já confirmada;


Requisitos e qualificações:

Escolaridade

  • Ensino Superior em andamento em: Administração, Processo Gerenciais, Gestão Financeira, Ciências Contábeis ou afins

Conhecimentos

  • Conhecimento em processos de faturamento e de cobrança
  • Conhecimento em legislação financeira
  • Excel intermediário


Benefícios:

Bolsa estágio;

Seguro de Vida;

Cartão multibenefícios (Alimentação + Refeição);

Day off de aniversário;

Wellhub by Gympass;

Auxílio home-office.
